entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that offers a universal memory layer for AI agents. It supports multi-level memory for User, Session, and Agent states and is available as a managed cloud service or an Apache-2.0 self-hosted OSS SDK.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine and sub-300ms recall. It automates fact extraction and user profile maintenance while supporting multi-modal extractors for various file types.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that utilizes a filesystem paradigm for unified context management. It features tiered L0/L1/L2 context loading and uses viking:// URIs to manage context.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: A brain for the Hermes Agent that utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges. It provides synthesized answers accompanied by citations and gap analysis.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system designed for long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It is available via Python and Node.js client SDKs and supports Docker-based deployment.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages context trees using git-like version control. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that utilizes a single SQLite database. It supports episodic compression for storage savings and integrates via MCP using stdio or SSE.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and playbooks. It supports Python and TypeScript surfaces and includes MCP server capabilities.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a SQLite-backed message store with FTS metadata. It builds a depth-aware summary DAG to provide compacted history for the agent.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for Honcho that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes a Docker setup script.
entries.plur-ai/plur: A shared memory layer for multi-agent systems that stores memory as plain-text YAML engrams on a local disk. It supports hierarchical scoping for project-specific or global knowledge.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: A local-first layer for identity, memory, and secrets that provides portable state across multiple clients including Hermes Agent. It includes a dashboard for inspecting, editing, and repairing memory.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device, local-first context engine that operates without cloud dependencies. It uses hybrid retrieval with BM25 and vector search and integrates via MCP and Claude Code hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: A plugin for accelerating long context LLM inference through context optimization. It uses block reordering and deduplication to reduce prefill latency and token usage.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: A durable, file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search. It avoids vector databases and embeddings, offering a five-package plugin family including an MCP server.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: A self-maintaining plugin that provides explainable recall with scoring reasons for every result. It includes contradiction tracking and a self-directing loop to identify knowledge gaps.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It uses SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide an evidence packet to the agent per query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by watching session logs. It utilizes local-first storage via SQLite-vec and GFUF models.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: A reflective memory system featuring semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It uses edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: A tool to reduce Hermes Agent tool-schema overhead through keyword selection and tool search. It uses local BM25 tool ranking to reduce prompt token overhead.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: A memory and context layer that resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens. It supports local-first and air-gap environments and integrates with MCP.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: A long-term, cross-project memory system that stores data as inspectable Markdown files. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and is daemonless.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin that uses a columnar.lbdb embedded graph database. It features importance-weighted recall to surface high-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that supports real, immediate event deletion. It provides an audit trace of prefetch operations via a trace.jsonl log.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: A memory provider that provides durable cross-session AI memory with semantic search. It includes provenance tracking, session snapshots, and TTL support.
entries.piprail/piprail: An SDK and MCP server that enables AI agents to pay for API usage using USDC and stablecoins. It supports multiple chain families including EVM and Solana.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: A memory plugin that integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term agent memory. It provides tools for manual memory storage and configurable query expansion.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: A plugin providing private local code memory for repositories through semantic search and file reads. It requires a local SourceVault server for functionality.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: A memory provider offering 17 tools for knowledge graph traversal and memory management. It uses hybrid search combining BM25, vector, and graph methods.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native long-term memory system featuring AES-256-GCM encryption at rest. It provides HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval alongside MinHash deduplication.

entries.obra/superpowers: A software development methodology and agentic skills framework utilizing a subagent-driven-development process. It provides skills for brainstorming and planning while emphasizing YAGNI and red/green TDD.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system that supports exports to HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4. It includes a cloud service for flagship models and CLI support for coding agents including Hermes Agent.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: A collection of 817 production-grade cybersecurity skills across 29 domains, compatible with Hermes Agent and 26+ AI platforms. These skills are mapped to six major frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill generates editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions by converting Mermaid text. It includes 11 diagram type presets and features auto-fix and self-check capabilities.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: An auditing tool compatible with Hermes and other agents that eliminates detectable AI writing patterns. It utilizes 53 pattern categories and a 111-entry word replacement table across Rewrite, Detect, and Edit modes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: An agentic evolver that enables collective skill evolution for shared user teams. It provides unified skill libraries across devices and automates quality improvement and deduplication.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 50 expert frameworks and 12 metaskills for orchestrating business and code journeys. It is compatible with agentskills.io-compatible agents and Claude Code.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: A trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce providing adjudication for deals via natural-language mandates and x402 payments. It includes escrow, dispute resolution, and a master router for protocol skills.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically propose and generate reusable skills. It produces Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation via dedicated slash commands.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: A type-safe implementation of the Agent Skills open specification for Pydantic AI. It reduces token consumption through progressive disclosure of metadata and supports programmatic or filesystem-based definitions.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: A suite of skills for Hermes Agent and other tools to extract transcripts, captions, and timestamps without yt-dlp. It also supports playlist extraction, channel browsing, and video search.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: Skills that enable Hermes Agent to generate its own analytical prompts using dynamic custom lenses via /prism-scan. It includes seven validated prisms and a /prism-reflect command for reporting analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: A set of workflow skills that transform rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs. It offers Lite and Full modes and utilizes evaluation models for a spec review gate.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: A harness for long-running agents featuring a three-level work model and structured memory via SQLite or file-backed cards. It includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards to support cross-feature learning.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: A literate programming skill that weaves code, diagrams, and prose into .lit.md files. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the documentation.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: A memory system that captures high-value decisions and outcomes via markdown files for cross-instance sharing. It includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Interoperable skills following the agentskills.io spec for interacting with smart contracts and Oracle networks. It supports Data Feeds, VRF, CCIP, and specialized ACE and CRE services.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Official skills for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 image generation, providing standardized prompting guidelines and API integration. It supports precise hex color specification and JSON structured prompting.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: A tool that converts documentation, repositories, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It generates version-pinned instruction files with provenance via documentation URLs or file citations.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: A registry for reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It features a CLI and Python client for installation with recursive dependency resolution and TON-based commerce.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: A skill for the autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time progress tracking. It includes checkpoints and built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that uses a three-layer lazy loading system to minimize token usage. It employs a socket-based daemon architecture for persistent connections and incremental metadata discovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: A Hermes Agent skill for managing Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It uses HTTPS with App Passwords and includes a guided setup script.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: A local-first workflow language for AI delivered as a single Rust binary under AGPL-3.0. It provides static auditing for types, permissions, and cost, generating tamper-evident execution receipts.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: A five-layer retrieval system for Hermes Agent that uses FTS5, dense embeddings, and hard triggers to narrow skill lists. This process reduces token usage and supports graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: A plugin that rewrites and scores prompts for various surfaces, including Discord and Telegram, based on model reasoning capabilities. It uses a local SQLite database to track token savings and quality scores.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: A read-only adversarial code review tool that uses three parallel subagents to attack code for exploits and integration risks. It integrates Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec via a deterministic pre-scan layer.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A .NET implementation of agentskills.io that integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading. It supports automatic directory registration and progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: An adaptation of verified procedures that implements multi-story task decomposition with evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine and a systematic protocol for causal debugging.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent skill for code simplification using a swarm of three agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness. It employs a risk-tiered triage system and detects language-specific anti-patterns.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing and one-click installation of skills, implementing the ARD v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure with federated search for Hugging Face and GitHub.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: A CLI and MCP server that allows agents to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for tools discovered via remoteopenclaw.com.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: A skill compatible with the agentskills.io standard that automates HTTP 402 payments using USDC. It supports multiple protocols, including x402, MPP, AP2, and Pay Link.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: A multi-scale Chinese news briefing generator for Hermes Agent that produces reports from global to street level. It utilizes semantic memory for search expansion and includes quality gates for AI analysis.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes. It includes various CLI and desktop tools that are updated daily.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository contains scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It features an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and provides configuration guides for running OpenClaw.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: This is a zero-install Windows desktop GUI that requires no admin rights. It features an integrated workflow engine for automated multi-step pipelines and includes an extensive toolset including TTS, Music, and ComfyUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project offers an automated Termux-based installation for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama and is compatible with providers like OpenAI and Anthropic.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart enables deployment on Kubernetes with cloud-native state-safety guardrails. It enforces single-writer state safety for persistent HERMES_HOME storage and supports configurable gateway mode.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides hardware-level enforcement for sandboxing Hermes Agent via NVIDIA OpenShell. It utilizes kernel-level restrictions for network and filesystem access and allows for configurable security policies.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This project offers a Nix package and NixOS module for reproducible Hermes deployment through declarative configuration. It supports hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is used to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps via a REST API, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate workspaces and identities. It provides hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, task scheduling, and enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework decomposes financial trading tasks into specialized roles, including fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysts. It supports multiple LLM providers alongside local Ollama models.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration system manages task assignment, execution review, and completion receipts. It offers a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API, complemented by a memory browser and relationship graph.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and mobile-friendly web dashboard for managing multiple coding agents, such as Claude Code, OpenCode, and Gemini CLI. It utilizes Docker sandboxing and git worktrees to ensure agent isolation.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single VPS agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, registry management, and VPS setup.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This level-based architecture enables scaling from individual agents to automated teams through an orchestrator-to-specialist task delegation pattern. It features bundled skills for backup management, security auditing, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This tool enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using multiple model providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work via a Kanban board. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics and code visualization.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: This delegation system routes tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code to prevent parent context pollution. It enforces safety through configurable timeouts and output character limits.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This project provides a local pre-indexed code knowledge graph via an MCP server to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It includes an auto-syncing local index and supports Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI tool designed to track token usage across various AI coding clients, including Hermes. It features a native Rust TUI in version 2 and offers cross-platform support.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows for the inspection of coding-agent API traffic, including system prompts, tool calls, and streaming responses. It enables users to compare adjacent requests for debugging and export portable HTML trace artifacts.
entries.bergside/typeui: This tool provides design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown or general prompting and integrates with Hermes Agent.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build, ship, and operate applications. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows and supports autonomous execution on laptops or a VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This CLI tool allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with various themes, such as cyberpunk or retro DOS aesthetics. It supports YAML-based configuration for modifying banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art banners.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous AI agents using encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable @handles and commerce via Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively in Claude Code without external processes or OAuth and includes MLOps tools for RL training, GGUF inference, and vLLM.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP. It features a visible UI for real-time AI supervision and includes session management and an integrated research desk.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup provides preconfigured skills and token-saving CLI workflows using RTK and Caveman templating. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance and offers automated installation for Linux and macOS.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: A TAW Agent framework that enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder scoping. It allows for seamless switching between scoped and default agents and supports custom instructions, tools, and project-local memories.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: A static linter used to check AI agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts without requiring model or API calls. It utilizes structural heuristics and static regex to support Markdown, plain text, JSON, YAML, and.prompt files.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: A migration tool that transfers skills, memory archives, SOUL.md, and MEMORY.md from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent. It maps OpenClaw credentials and configs into Hermes YAML and JSON formats and sets up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides self-healing for multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a beta Hermes plugin that exports telemetry for tool calls and API requests, alongside automated health monitoring and token intelligence tracking.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides an all-in-one interface to manage multiple agentic tools including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork app for macOS, Windows, and Linux that supports various agent CLIs. It features a built-in agent engine with file access and automates the creation of Word, Excel, and PPT documents.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A Python and vanilla JavaScript web interface designed for use on browsers or mobile devices. It provides a three-panel layout with chat and workspace file browsing, maintaining full parity with the Hermes CLI experience.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app that facilitates guided installation and provider setup for Hermes Agent. It offers a GUI for managing chat, sessions, and tools across multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: A web dashboard featuring a file browser, web terminal, and usage analytics. It supports multi-platform AI chat and unified configuration for channels such as Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace that includes a terminal, memory browser, skills manager, and inspector panel. It utilizes tmux-backed workers and a Monaco-based file browser to support Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that enables direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes embedded terminal access for shell and system repair, alongside native views for Kanban, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension compatible with Chrome, Edge, and Chromium. It connects active browser contexts to local, remote gateways, or Hermes Cloud runtimes to provide a full-page web workspace.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust that supports Windows and macOS. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime and supports Markdown and LaTeX rendering.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard providing a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS application that serves as a session browser, agent cockpit, and analytics tool. It provides searchable history for Hermes and other coding-agent CLIs, including live per-session quota burn rates.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace designed for interacting with SSH hosts and Orgo cloud computers. It features one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode via Orgo MCP.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative terminal dashboard built with OpenTUI that consolidates Hermes Agent chat, sessions, and configuration. It includes integrated kanban boards and an extensible Eikon avatar system.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A React-based mobile-first SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses, file attachments, and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable, no-install Windows desktop application that requires no admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools—such as TTS, Music, and ComfyUI—and a workflow engine for multi-step automation pipelines.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted Hermes Agent assistance. It integrates real-time log streaming, a file browser, a task tracking dashboard, and management tools for MCP servers and skills.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A configuration and process monitoring dashboard for Hermes. It provides real-time visibility into session activity, cost tracking, and the inspection of skill source code and conversation histories.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, alongside isolated profile management for API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A multi-agent desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and a native interface for streaming SSE responses.
